text:
Sorry about that, two identical charges are worrying to see. Here's what to check first.

**1. Is one of them a pending authorisation?**
Cards are authorised at checkout and only charged when the order ships, so one of the two may be a temporary hold rather than a real charge. If the order was cancelled, a pending authorisation drops off on its own in **3-7 business days**, depending on your bank. Leafy can't release it any faster.

**2. Was the order split into several parcels?**
An order that ships in more than one parcel can show one charge per parcel. Check whether your order has multiple shipments in "My Orders".

**3. If both charges have fully posted**
Please send me:
- Your **order number** (it looks like LF-123456)
- The **last four digits** of the card used

Once we confirm the duplicate, it will be refunded within **3 business days** of confirmation. The refund goes back to the original payment method.

Please don't share your full card number, security code or any passwords. I don't need them.

Can you tell me whether both charges show as posted or one shows as pending, and send the details above?
